dropped.reason: Viewport-meta pinch zoom (mobile); Electron and desktop browsers ignore it.
dvh vs vh only differs on mobile browsers.
dvh vs vh only differs on mobile browsers.
Full-width button inset is a mobile value (16px on phones).
Swipe rows (touch-only gesture); a11y-keyboard-path-for-pointer still covers any drag UI.

rules.title: Native controls
rules.rule: Actions are <button>, navigation is <a href>; never a <div> or <span> with onClick.

rules.title: Interactive roles need keyboard
rules.rule: An element with an interactive ARIA role implements that role's full keyboard model.

rules.title: No redundant roles
rules.rule: Do not add a role that repeats native semantics (<button role="button">).

rules.title: No aria-label on generic elements
rules.rule: Never put aria-label on a <div> or <span> with no role.

rules.title: ARIA references resolve
rules.rule: aria-labelledby and aria-describedby point at IDs that exist.

rules.title: Navigation is not a menu
rules.rule: Site navigation is <nav> with a list, never role="menu".

rules.title: One disabled mechanism
rules.rule: Never set both disabled and aria-disabled; aria-disabled controls block activation in code.

rules.title: No tooltip on disabled controls
rules.rule: A natively disabled control carries no tooltip; show the reason as text or use aria-disabled.

rules.title: Style :focus-visible
rules.rule: Style focus with :focus-visible, not bare :focus.

rules.title: No outline removal without replacement
rules.rule: Never remove the outline (outline: none, outline-none, outline-0) without a verified :focus-visible replacement.

rules.title: Visible focus
rules.rule: Every keyboard-reachable control shows a visible focus indicator.
rules.notes: DS tokens border.width.focus (2px) and focus.ring.offset (2px) already match the magazine's 2px/2px.

rules.title: Focus ring contrast
rules.rule: A focus ring reaches 3:1 against every adjacent color it crosses.

rules.title: Forced-colors edges
rules.rule: Focus and control edges stay visible in forced-colors mode.

rules.title: Focus not obscured
rules.rule: A focused element is never fully hidden behind sticky headers, footers or banners.

rules.title: Sticky header offset
rules.rule: With a sticky header, anchors and focused elements land below it (scroll-padding-block-start or scroll-margin-block-start equal to its height).

rules.title: Keyboard path for everything
rules.rule: Every pointer interaction has a keyboard path; the whole interface works from the keyboard.

rules.title: Escape closes overlays
rules.rule: Escape closes the most recently opened overlay (tooltip, then menu, then dialog).

rules.title: No positive tabindex
rules.rule: Never use tabindex above 0.

rules.title: Composite widgets are one Tab stop
rules.rule: Tabs, menus, toolbars and radio groups occupy one Tab stop.

rules.title: APG key map
rules.rule: Custom composite widgets implement the APG keys: arrows move, Home/End jump, Enter/Space activate.

rules.title: Dialog focus
rules.rule: Dialogs make the background inert, move focus inside on open and return it to the trigger on close.

rules.title: Dialog semantics
rules.rule: A custom overlay has role=dialog, aria-modal=true and a name, or is a native <dialog>.

rules.title: Headless primitives for overlays
rules.rule: Build dialogs, selects and menus on a headless primitive (Base UI or Radix), not from scratch.

rules.title: Safe default focus
rules.rule: A destructive confirmation focuses the least destructive action on open.

rules.title: Route change focus and title
rules.rule: On a client-side route change, update document.title and move focus to the new view's <h1> or <main>.

rules.title: Specific title first
rules.rule: <title> names the current context, most specific first (Billing · Settings · App).

rules.title: Hit target size
rules.rule: Every interactive target is at least 32x32 CSS px (fail under 24px, warn under 32px), extending a small visual with a pseudo-element hit area.
rules.notes: Ford's decision. The 44px touch and 40px dense-desktop aims are dropped; the 24px WCAG spacing exception still applies to the fail tier.

rules.title: Hit areas never overlap
rules.rule: Extended hit areas of neighbouring controls never overlap.

rules.title: No dead zones
rules.rule: Adjacent list and menu items, and a checkbox or radio with its label, share hit area with no dead gap between them.

rules.title: Decorative layers pass clicks
rules.rule: Decorative overlays (glows, scrims, full-bleed ::after) have pointer-events: none.

rules.title: Drag has a single-pointer alternative
rules.rule: Every drag (block reorder, resize) has a click or keyboard alternative.

rules.title: Inputs have labels
rules.rule: Every input has a programmatic label; a placeholder never stands in for one.

rules.title: Autocomplete tokens
rules.rule: Fields about the user carry a valid autocomplete token.

rules.title: Right input type
rules.rule: Inputs use the matching type, and spellcheck=false on emails, codes and usernames.
rules.notes: The inputmode (mobile keyboard) half is dropped for desktop.

rules.title: Never block paste
rules.rule: Never block paste into a field.

rules.title: Validate on submit
rules.rule: Validate on submit; never natively disable submit to gate validation (use aria-disabled plus a handler guard when a step needs input).
rules.notes: Conflict: issue 12 keeps Continue disabled until input. Resolved to the skill's stricter rule with aria-disabled.

rules.title: Errors are announced
rules.rule: Failing fields get aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby to inline error text, and focus moves to the first invalid field.

rules.title: No keystroke filtering
rules.rule: Accept free text and validate after; never block or filter characters while typing.

rules.title: Pending submit
rules.rule: While submitting, show a spinner beside the original label and mark the button aria-disabled.

rules.title: Unsaved changes
rules.rule: Warn on unsaved changes before navigation; re-renders never reset typed values or steal focus.

rules.title: Every control has a name
rules.rule: Every interactive control, icon-only ones included, has an accessible name.

rules.title: Visible label in the name
rules.rule: The visible label appears in the accessible name, ideally at its start; no aria-label where visible text already names the control.

rules.title: aria-hidden is not focusable
rules.rule: aria-hidden is never on or above a focusable element.

rules.title: Not color alone
rules.rule: Status and meaning are never carried by color alone; pair with an icon, text or underline.

rules.title: Text contrast
rules.rule: Text reaches 4.5:1 (large text, 24px+ or 18.67px+ bold, 3:1) against the background it actually renders on, in light and dark, including translucent surfaces.

rules.title: Non-text contrast
rules.rule: Control boundaries, states and meaningful graphics reach 3:1 against adjacent colors.

rules.title: APCA report
rules.rule: Report APCA Lc alongside WCAG 2 (body Lc 75, labels 60, large 45, icons 30-45); gate on WCAG 2 only.

rules.title: Legible placeholder and disabled text
rules.rule: Disabled and placeholder text aims for APCA Lc 30.

rules.title: Reduced-motion gate
rules.rule: Every keyframe or enter animation is opt-in under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference (motion-safe:), with one app-wide MotionConfig reducedMotion="user".
rules.notes: Ford's decision: reduced-motion rules are warnings only.

rules.title: Reduced motion keeps the fade
rules.rule: Under reduce, movement, scale and blur become an opacity cross-fade; feedback stays, and the press scale stays as functional feedback.
rules.notes: Skills conflict 1 (press scale under reduce) resolved: keep it.

rules.title: Pause moving content
rules.rule: Anything moving or auto-updating for more than 5s has a visible pause control.

rules.title: Toast timing
rules.rule: Toasts with an action or error stay until dismissed; timed toasts last 5s or more and pause on hover or focus.

rules.title: Polite status announcements
rules.rule: Status changes without a focus move (copied, saved) go through a polite live region rendered empty before the update.

rules.title: Assertive only when urgent
rules.rule: role=alert or aria-live=assertive only for urgent errors; success and status use role=status.

rules.title: Never focus a toast
rules.rule: Never move focus to a toast.

rules.title: Images have alt
rules.rule: Every has an alt attribute.

rules.title: Alt by purpose
rules.rule: Alt text says what the image communicates or does; decorative images use alt="".
rules.notes: Text-only judge over extracted alt strings.

rules.title: SVG semantics
rules.rule: Decorative SVGs and icons inside labelled controls are aria-hidden; meaningful standalone SVGs have role=img and a name.

rules.title: Media captions
rules.rule: Prerecorded video has captions, audio a transcript, and nothing autoplays with sound.

rules.title: One main
rules.rule: Expose exactly one visible primary <main> landmark.

rules.title: Skip link
rules.rule: When repeated navigation precedes <main>, a skip link is the first focusable element.

rules.title: Heading outline
rules.rule: Headings describe their sections and form a coherent outline.

rules.title: Labelled landmarks
rules.rule: Several landmarks of one type carry distinguishing labels.

rules.title: 200% text resize
rules.rule: All content and controls survive 200% text resize.

rules.title: rem media queries
rules.rule: Write media queries in rem or em.

rules.title: Toggle state exposed
rules.rule: Tab and toggle buttons expose aria-pressed or aria-selected; non-submit buttons have type=button.

rules.title: Safe shortcuts
rules.rule: Shortcuts use sequences (G then I) or modifiers, avoid browser-reserved combos, and never put a destructive action on one key.

rules.title: Shortcuts ignore fields
rules.rule: Shortcuts ignore keystrokes in form fields, IME composition and key repeat.

rules.title: Enter submits
rules.rule: Fields and their submit button sit in a <form>, so Enter advances or submits each step.

rules.title: Focus the primary action
rules.rule: On a step with no input, focus moves to the primary button so Enter still works.

rules.title: Escape steps back
rules.rule: In a multi-step dialog, Escape goes back one step and closes only from the first step.

rules.title: Autofocus the next input
rules.rule: Autofocus the next input the user must fill.

rules.title: Groups by space
rules.rule: The gap between groups is at least 2x the gap within a group.

rules.title: Separators last
rules.rule: Use a separator only where space cannot carry structure, as a low-contrast hairline, never beside a large gap that already did the job.

rules.title: Controls look like controls
rules.rule: Every interactive element has a shape, border, underline or consistent placement zone; a control never looks like static text.

rules.title: Static is not control-shaped
rules.rule: A non-clickable badge never looks exactly like the buttons beside it.

rules.title: Shared edges
rules.rule: Content aligns to a small set of shared edges, with one spacing step per nesting level.

rules.title: Numbers align end
rules.rule: Numbers in tables are text-align: end; text is start.
rules.notes: Same numeric-cell scan as R-tabular-nums.

rules.title: Logical properties
rules.rule: Direction-dependent layout uses logical properties (margin-inline-start, text-align: start).

rules.title: RTL overrides
rules.rule: float uses inline-start; translateX and background-position on mirrored UI have a [dir=rtl] override.
rules.notes: Only when the app supports RTL.

rules.title: RTL mirror
rules.rule: Under dir=rtl the layout mirrors cleanly, progression included.
rules.notes: Only when the app supports RTL.

rules.title: DOM order is visual order
rules.rule: Visual order matches DOM order; never reorder with order, row-reverse or grid placement.

rules.title: Importance order
rules.rule: The most important content sits top and leading; identity leads, metadata and actions trail.

rules.title: One primary, few secondaries
rules.rule: Each view has one primary action; more than 3 secondary actions go behind a menu.

rules.title: Hidden content has a cue
rules.rule: Off-screen or collapsed content has a visible cue: a peeking item, scroll affordance or disclosure.

rules.title: Truncation has a way back
rules.rule: Truncated text the user needs has a way to the full text (expand, detail view, keyboard-reachable tooltip); a hover-only title does not count.
rules.notes: Skill is stricter than issue 15 (any tooltip); skill wins.

rules.title: Disclosures name content
rules.rule: Disclosure controls name what is hidden ('Show 12 more results', not 'More').

rules.title: Control clearance
rules.rule: Leave about 12px between bordered or filled controls and about 24px between borderless text or icon controls, unless an established density says otherwise.

rules.title: Content bleeds, controls stay inside
rules.rule: Backgrounds and media may bleed to the edges; controls and text stay inside layout margins.

rules.title: No horizontal page scroll
rules.rule: At every supported desktop window width the page never scrolls horizontally (width: 100%, never 100vw).
rules.notes: Desktop widths only (Ford's decision).

rules.title: min-height for text boxes
rules.rule: Boxes holding text use min-height (or max-height with overflow auto), never a fixed height.

rules.title: Tracks can shrink
rules.rule: Grid tracks with long content use minmax(0, 1fr) and flex children min-width: 0.

rules.title: Container queries
rules.rule: Reusable components adapt with @container, not viewport @media.

rules.title: Container has a definite width
rules.rule: An element with container-type: inline-size has a definite width.

rules.title: Text can grow
rules.rule: Labels and buttons have no fixed widths and rows wrap, so longer strings fit.

rules.title: Critical actions reachable
rules.rule: Critical actions never get clipped by resize, zoom or scroll; modals cap at the viewport height with actions outside the scroll area.

rules.title: Breakpoints from content
rules.rule: Breakpoints come from where the layout stops fitting, not device presets.

rules.title: Three font families at most
rules.rule: Use at most three font families; fewer is better.

rules.title: Weight floor
rules.rule: Below 18px use weight 400 or heavier; weights 100-300 only at 28px and up.
rules.notes: Read from the same computed-font inventory as R-min-font.

rules.title: No synthesized faces
rules.rule: Load every weight and style the design uses so the browser never synthesizes one.
rules.notes: Issue 14 suggests font-synthesis: none; the skill forbids it globally (see typo-no-global-synthesis-none). Skill wins.

rules.title: No global font-synthesis: none
rules.rule: Never set font-synthesis: none on body or interface text.

rules.title: Properties over feature tags
rules.rule: Use font-weight and font-variant-* where a property exists, not font-variation-settings or font-feature-settings.

rules.title: Small type scale
rules.rule: Use a small type scale, each size paired with its line-height and weight, with few sizes and weights in use.

rules.title: Sizes from tokens
rules.rule: Font sizes, spacing, radii, shadows and fonts come from design-system tokens; no arbitrary values (w-[343px], p-[13px]).
rules.notes: Already gated by lint:apps (scan-literals). No design-score check id yet.

rules.title: Headings descend
rules.rule: Heading sizes descend with level and a heading is never smaller than body text.

rules.title: Unitless line-height
rules.rule: line-height is unitless.
rules.notes: DS line-height.code (21px) and line-height.row (28px) are px on purpose: they set row heights. They are exempt.

rules.title: Line height by role
rules.rule: Display 1.1, headings 1.2-1.3, body 1.5-1.6.
rules.notes: DS line-height.reading is 1.45, under the 1.5 floor. See token proposals.

rules.title: Wrapping text leading
rules.rule: Text that wraps to three or more lines has line-height 1.4 or more.

rules.title: Letter spacing by size
rules.rule: Headings 24px+ take -0.01em to -0.02em, uppercase labels 14px and under take about 0.05em, body stays 0.
rules.notes: DS uppercase labels use 0.09em and 0.14em. See token proposals.

rules.title: Letter spacing in em
rules.rule: letter-spacing is set in em, not px.

rules.title: Kerning on
rules.rule: Never set font-kerning: none.

rules.title: Line length
rules.rule: Long-form text is capped at 60-75 characters per line.
rules.notes: DS layout.lane.text is 60ch, inside the band.

rules.title: Balance headings
rules.rule: Headings and titles use text-wrap: balance.

rules.title: No balance on paragraphs
rules.rule: Never use text-wrap: balance on paragraphs.
rules.notes: Issue 15 also bans pretty on long-form; the skill allows pretty on paragraphs. Skill wins (see typo-pretty-body).

rules.title: Pretty paragraphs
rules.rule: Body paragraphs and short descriptions use text-wrap: pretty.

rules.title: Break long strings
rules.rule: Where a long word, URL or ID could escape its container, set overflow-wrap: break-word.

rules.title: Labels do not wrap
rules.rule: Labels and badges that look broken when wrapped use white-space: nowrap.

rules.title: No justify
rules.rule: Interface text is text-align: start; never justify.

rules.title: Tabular numbers
rules.rule: Timers, counters, prices and numeric columns use tabular-nums; prose figures stay proportional.

rules.title: Complete line clamp
rules.rule: -webkit-line-clamp is paired with display: -webkit-box and -webkit-box-orient: vertical.

rules.title: Natural case
rules.rule: Store text in natural case and set case with text-transform.

rules.title: Typographic punctuation
rules.rule: Rendered text uses the ellipsis character, en dashes in ranges and curly quotes; code keeps straight quotes.

rules.title: Tuned underlines
rules.rule: Underlines use from-font position and thickness, or a tuned offset and 1-2px thickness, with skip-ink auto.

rules.title: Skip-ink on
rules.rule: Never set text-decoration-skip-ink: none.

rules.title: Font size floors
rules.rule: Long-form body starts at 16px, UI text about 14px (13px in dense tools), captions 13px, rarely below 12px.
rules.notes: DS micro (10px) and ui-2xs (11px) sit under the 12px floor; each use warns.

rules.title: rem font sizes
rules.rule: font-size is set in rem so the reader's browser font size applies.
rules.notes: DS font sizes are px except title. Low impact in desktop Electron apps.

rules.title: Smoothing on the root
rules.rule: Set -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased and -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale once on the root.

rules.title: lang and dir
rules.rule: Set lang on the document and dir wherever direction changes.

rules.title: Trim text boxes
rules.rule: In buttons and badges, trim text boxes (text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic) so labels center optically.

rules.title: No text images
rules.rule: Decorative text is CSS, not images.

rules.title: Content selectable, chrome not
rules.rule: Content text stays selectable; user-select: none only on control chrome and drag surfaces.

rules.title: woff2 fonts
rules.rule: Serve web fonts as woff2.

rules.title: Self-host fonts
rules.rule: Self-host fonts instead of loading them from a third-party CDN.

rules.title: font-display swap
rules.rule: Set font-display: swap with a similar system fallback stack.

rules.title: Pair fonts for contrast
rules.rule: Pair fonts for contrast, never two near-identical sans-serifs.

rules.title: Readable selection
rules.rule: Style ::selection to match the brand and keep selected text readable.
rules.notes: DS color.selection covers it.

rules.title: Display and Text cuts
rules.rule: Use a family's Display cut at large sizes and its Text cut at small ones.

rules.title: Emphasis is one weight step
rules.rule: Emphasis within a role is one weight step up, not a size change.

rules.title: No color literals
rules.rule: Components hold no hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch() literals, and a change never swaps a token for a literal or a lighter token without remeasuring.

rules.title: One color notation
rules.rule: Write colors in the project's notation (DS: lowercase hex).

rules.title: Semantic tokens in components
rules.rule: Components use semantic role tokens; hue tokens only for categorical color.
rules.notes: Matches DS rule 4.

rules.title: Token names by role
rules.rule: Semantic token names describe a role, never a hue, component or position.

rules.title: Accent is the brand word
rules.rule: Call the brand color 'accent' so 'primary' never means two things.

rules.title: Tokens in their role
rules.rule: Use a token only in its role: no border token in color:, no text token in background:, no accent on text.
rules.notes: DS rule 5: text uses color.link, never color.accent.

rules.title: One word per concept
rules.rule: Pick one word per concept (text, bg, border, accent) and never mix synonyms.

rules.title: Ramps hold one hue
rules.rule: A ramp steps lightness at one perceived hue.

rules.title: Fine light end
rules.rule: Light-end steps sit about 0.04-0.05 OKLCH L apart; mid-ramp 0.07-0.10.

rules.title: Distinct steps
rules.rule: No two adjacent ramp steps are within 0.03 OKLCH L.

rules.title: Chroma peaks mid-ramp
rules.rule: Vividness peaks mid-ramp and falls off at both ends.

rules.title: Ramp ends not pure
rules.rule: Ramps stop short of pure black and white.

rules.title: Sibling hues match
rules.rule: Sibling hues share OKLCH lightness and relative chroma so the same step reads equally bright.

rules.title: Status hues apart from accent
rules.rule: Every status hue sits 15 degrees or more of OKLCH hue from the accent.

rules.title: One color, one meaning
rules.rule: A color (within 15 degrees of hue) has one purpose across the interface.

rules.title: One filled action
rules.rule: One primary action per view gets the filled accent; peers stay neutral.

rules.title: Semantic color keeps its meaning
rules.rule: A semantic color is never used against its meaning.

rules.title: No unused steps
rules.rule: Every palette step has a purpose; remove ramps and steps nothing renders.

rules.title: No near-duplicate colors
rules.rule: Colors within 0.02 OKLab deltaE are one drifted color; collapse them.

rules.title: Real dark palette
rules.rule: Dark tokens are a separate palette, not the light ramp reversed.

rules.title: One theme mechanism
rules.rule: Switch themes one way only.
rules.notes: DS uses data-theme="dark" with .dark as an alias of the same selector; that counts as one mechanism.

rules.title: Dark coverage
rules.rule: When dark ships, every custom color has a dark variant.

rules.title: prefers-contrast per appearance
rules.rule: prefers-contrast: more gets its own value per appearance, widening the gap by 0.15 L or more.

rules.title: In-gamut colors
rules.rule: oklch() colors stay in the target gamut, with an sRGB value first and vivid values inside @media (color-gamut: p3).
rules.notes: DS colors are hex today, so this applies only to new oklch values.

rules.title: Consistent neutral tint
rules.rule: A neutral's tint is held across its ramp.

rules.title: Full role inventory
rules.rule: The token set covers every role: surfaces, text levels, borders, focus, accent and shipped statuses.

rules.title: Gradient interpolation space
rules.rule: Multi-hue gradients declare their space: oklab by default, oklch only for vivid midpoints checked for detours; keep text off gradients.
rules.notes: Skill calls this taste; magazine states it. Kept as warn with oklab default.

rules.title: No hue detours
rules.rule: oklch gradients show no intermediate hues you never defined.

rules.title: Round glows are circles
rules.rule: Set circle explicitly when a radial glow must stay round.

rules.title: Locale color meaning
rules.rule: Gain/loss colors that change meaning across locales are per-locale tokens.

rules.title: Gradient techniques
rules.rule: Hard edges with same-position stops, textures with repeating gradients, midpoints with color hints, richness with a low-alpha blended layer.

rules.title: Concentric radius
rules.rule: Nested rounded surfaces use outer radius = inner radius + padding (+ border width), up to a 24px inset.
rules.notes: DS has one 2px radius. Skip pairs where both radii are radius.base; check when either radius is above 4px.

rules.title: Concentric focus ring
rules.rule: An offset focus ring's radius equals the element radius plus the offset.

rules.title: Less padding on the icon side
rules.rule: A button with an icon and text takes 2-4px less padding on its icon side.
rules.notes: Skill says about 2px; issue 09 shows 4px. Both pass.

rules.title: Optical glyph alignment
rules.rule: Asymmetric icons (play, star) are aligned optically, preferably fixed in the SVG.

rules.title: Shadows for depth
rules.rule: A border that only creates depth (cards over images or colored backgrounds) becomes a layered transparent shadow; structural, input, divider and selected borders stay.
rules.notes: The DS draws frames with hairline borders, so the DS wins; this applies only where a border fights an image or colored backdrop.

rules.title: Darker shadow on hover
rules.rule: On hover use the same shadow slightly darker and transition only box-shadow.

rules.title: Shadow ring keeps a border
rules.rule: A box-shadow ring keeps border: 1px solid transparent for forced-colors mode.

rules.title: Image outline
rules.rule: Content images get a 1px outline inset 1px in pure black at 10% (light) or pure white at 10% (dark).
rules.notes: Issue 19 says 8%; issues 09 and the skill say 10%. 10% wins. Needs a DS token (see token proposals).

rules.title: Images match the UI
rules.rule: Outline avatars when neighbouring controls have borders, not when they don't.

rules.title: Icon stroke matches text
rules.rule: An icon's rendered stroke tracks the adjacent text weight: 1.5px at 400, 2px at 500-600, 2.5px at 700.

rules.title: One icon library
rules.rule: Use one icon library per surface.

rules.title: Icons use currentColor
rules.rule: Icons use currentColor and get states from CSS color and opacity, never hardcoded fills.

rules.title: Outline default, fill active
rules.rule: Outline is the default icon variant; fill marks the active state only.

rules.title: Icon mirroring
rules.rule: Under dir=rtl mirror only icons whose meaning follows reading direction.
rules.notes: Only when the app supports RTL.

rules.title: Inline icon size
rules.rule: Inline icons are 1em-1.25em of the adjacent font size.

rules.title: SVG icons
rules.rule: Icons are SVG, never raster, on the grid that matches their render size.
rules.notes: Knowledge System's Better Creating icons are 96x96 PNG masks; each warns until they move to SVG or Ford accepts them.

rules.title: One way per detail
rules.rule: The same detail (radius, shadow, motion curve) is done one way across the project.

rules.title: Motion from tokens
rules.rule: Durations, easings, springs and press scale come from design-system motion tokens, defined once (MotionConfig or the token), never as ms or cubic-bezier literals.
rules.notes: DS rule 2 forbids duration literals; Jakub's values become tokens (token proposals).

rules.title: Transitions for state
rules.rule: Interactive state changes use transitions or springs so they reverse mid-way; keyframes only for one-shot sequences.

rules.title: Press scale
rules.rule: Buttons scale to 0.95-0.98 while pressed, over about 150ms ease-out, with an opt-out.
rules.notes: Ford's decision replaces the skill's exact 0.96. Duration: skill 150ms, issue 19 200ms; the shorter wins.

rules.title: Disabled never scales
rules.rule: A disabled button never scales on press.

rules.title: Keyboard press feedback
rules.rule: Press feedback also fires on keyboard activation.

rules.title: Frequent interactions are instant
rules.rule: Keystrokes, row and menu-item hovers and tab switches are instant or 150ms or less of opacity or background-color, with no entrance animation.

rules.title: No open animation on frequent menus
rules.rule: Surfaces opened many times a day (context menus) do not animate open; animate the close only, if at all.

rules.title: No animated data swaps
rules.rule: Content swaps between data tabs show the new data at once.

rules.title: Duration by size
rules.rule: Duration scales with what moves: small 150ms, menus and tabs 250ms, modals, drawers and panels 350-450ms.
rules.notes: DS durations are 100/150/260ms. See token proposals.

rules.title: Easing by purpose
rules.rule: ease-out for enter and exit, linear for loading and continuous motion, a no-bounce spring for morphs; never ease-in on UI.
rules.notes: M-duration reads easing from the same getAnimations() record.

rules.title: Exits shorter and smaller
rules.rule: Exits are shorter and smaller than enters: opacity, 4px blur, a fixed 12px move or a 0.99 scale over 150ms ease-out, never the full container height.
rules.notes: Issue 09 slides to -70%; the skill's fixed 12px is stricter and wins.

rules.title: Staggered entrances
rules.rule: Infrequent staged entrances split into chunks staggered 100ms, each opacity + 4px blur + 12px translateY over 300ms ease-out; never stagger routine interactions.
rules.notes: Issue 09's hero uses 800ms, 8px and 8px blur; product UI uses the skill's values.

rules.title: Scale inverse to size
rules.rule: Small elements scale in from 0.96-0.97, large ones from 0.98-0.99.

rules.title: Scale from the trigger
rules.rule: Popovers, menus, tooltips and anchored badges scale from their trigger or anchor corner, not the center.

rules.title: Small travel
rules.rule: Travel stays small: 4px for text swaps, about 8px for page transitions, 8-32px for most elements, up to 70% for sheets.

rules.title: Direction from source
rules.rule: Motion shows where things come from: menus from the trigger, panels from their side, indicators between positions, nav dropdowns shift about 8px in the direction of travel.

rules.title: Motion is not the only cue
rules.rule: Every animated state change leaves a static cue.

rules.title: No animation on mount
rules.rule: State swaps and page elements do not animate on first render unless it is an intended entrance (initial={false}).

rules.title: Icon swap cross-fade
rules.rule: Icon swaps cross-fade with scale 0.25 to 1, opacity 0 to 1, blur 4px to 0 over 300ms (spring bounce 0 or cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)).

rules.title: No bounce
rules.rule: Springs, gesture springs included, have bounce 0.
rules.notes: Issue 17 allows a subtle bounce; the skill's 0 is stricter and wins.

rules.title: No transitions on theme switch
rules.rule: Transitions are suppressed while the theme switches.

rules.title: No transition: all
rules.rule: Transitions name exact properties, never all.

rules.title: Scoped will-change
rules.rule: will-change names transform, opacity or filter, only on elements that animate, never all or broad selectors.

rules.title: Compositor-only animation
rules.rule: Animate transform, opacity and filter, never left, top, width, height or margin.
rules.notes: Measured container height morphs (12-height-animates-between-steps) and Motion layout animations warn instead of fail.

rules.title: Animate gradients cheaply
rules.rule: Animate a gradient's position, angle or size, not its color stops.

rules.title: No jitter while animating
rules.rule: Text and icons never shift 1-2px while an element animates (add will-change: transform).

rules.title: Hover behind a media query
rules.rule: Hover-only styling sits behind @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
rules.notes: Desktop-only apps: kept as warn because touch screens on laptops still latch hover.

rules.title: Contained overscroll
rules.rule: Scrollable dialogs, drawers, menus and side panels use overscroll-behavior: contain.

rules.title: Fill mode for hidden starts
rules.rule: Hidden start states live in the from keyframe with animation-fill-mode: both.

rules.title: Shared element moves
rules.rule: An element that moves between states (tab pill, card to dialog) animates with a shared layoutId, not a cut.

rules.title: Unique layoutId
rules.rule: Never render two elements with the same layoutId in one state.

rules.title: layoutId outside AnimatePresence
rules.rule: Keep layoutId elements outside AnimatePresence.

rules.title: Keyed presence fade
rules.rule: Content that appears with a layout change uses AnimatePresence with a stable key and opacity plus 4px blur.

rules.title: Radius through animate
rules.rule: Radius that differs between layout states goes through Motion's animate or style, not className.

rules.title: cn for classes
rules.rule: Compose class names with a cn utility, not template literals.

rules.title: Tap cancels on move
rules.rule: A tap cancels when the pointer moves more than 3px, so taps never fire during drags.

rules.title: Drag stays in its container
rules.rule: Free-drag elements are constrained to their container.

rules.title: Subtle focus motion
rules.rule: Focus animations stay subtle; no complex motion during keyboard navigation.

rules.title: Scroll reveal
rules.rule: Scroll reveals start from a defined state (blur 8px to 0) once half the element is visible.

rules.title: Labels fade with resize
rules.rule: When a container resizes (sidebar collapse), its labels fade in step, never appear or vanish instantly.

rules.title: No height: auto animation
rules.rule: Never animate height to or from auto; measure and animate to a number.

rules.title: Height morphs between steps
rules.rule: When a container's content changes size, interpolate its height (spring bounce 0, 0.3s) instead of jumping.

rules.title: Measure the inner wrapper
rules.rule: The measuring ref sits on an inner wrapper, never on the animated element.

rules.title: No zero-height first frame
rules.rule: The first state has a known height so a dialog never opens by growing from 0.

rules.title: Step cross-fade
rules.rule: Swapped step content cross-fades with AnimatePresence mode popLayout, initial false, opacity and scale 0.95 to 1.

rules.title: Tab label above indicator
rules.rule: Tab labels sit above the moving active indicator so it never covers them.

rules.title: Linear loaders
rules.rule: Looping loaders rotate linearly and stop under reduced motion.

rules.title: LazyMotion
rules.rule: Use m components inside LazyMotion to keep Motion's full bundle out of the main chunk.

rules.title: Not over-animated
rules.rule: Feedback animation stays subtle; no stacking of several effects on one interaction.

rules.title: Low cognitive load
rules.rule: Screens are simple and predictable.

rules.title: Fast action feedback
rules.rule: Common actions show their result fast, optimistically when the server is slow.

rules.title: Fast page load
rules.rule: Entry pages load as fast as possible.

rules.title: Copy feedback keeps width
rules.rule: Copy feedback swaps the icon and keeps the label so the button keeps its width.

rules.title: Tooltip skip delay
rules.rule: Once a tooltip shows, neighbours show instantly for a short window, from one app-wide provider.

rules.title: Theme before first paint
rules.rule: The resolved theme applies before first paint; the app follows the system with a Light, Dark and System choice.

rules.title: Narrow will-change hints
rules.rule: Use will-change: scroll-position or contents only for their narrow cases.

rules.title: Slider springs
rules.rule: Animate slider thumb and fill with springs.

rules.title: Consistent terms
rules.rule: Each object and action has one name across the product.
rules.notes: Text-only judge over extracted strings.

rules.title: One flow vocabulary
rules.rule: A multi-step flow uses one forward label at every step (Continue, not Continue/Next/Proceed), then Done.

rules.title: Tone by stakes
rules.rule: Tone flexes with stakes: warm for success, neutral for routine, calm for errors, serious for data loss.
rules.notes: Text-only judge.

rules.title: Address the reader
rules.rule: Write 'you', not 'the user'; avoid 'we' in errors.

rules.title: Plain words
rules.rule: Plain words a tired reader gets on first pass; no idioms; match the device verb (click on desktop).
rules.notes: Text-only judge.

rules.title: Whole strings
rules.rule: Never assemble sentences from fragments or hand-roll plurals; use one ICU message.

rules.title: Intl formatting
rules.rule: Numbers, dates, times, prices and lists go through Intl with the user's locale and time zone.

rules.title: Verb-first buttons
rules.rule: Button labels start with a verb naming the action ('Delete project' beside 'Cancel'), never OK, Yes or No.

rules.title: Names state the action
rules.rule: A control's name states the action ('Copy link'), never the glyph ('Chain icon', 'X').

rules.title: Descriptive links
rules.rule: Link text makes sense out of context; no 'Click here'.

rules.title: One capitalization policy
rules.rule: One capitalization policy per element type, sentence case by default.

rules.title: Toggles name the on state
rules.rule: Toggle labels describe the ON state; never start with Don't, Disable or Hide.

rules.title: Link to settings
rules.rule: Link straight to a referenced setting instead of describing a path.

rules.title: Errors say the fix
rules.rule: Every error says what failed and how to fix it, beside the field that broke.

rules.title: No Oops
rules.rule: No blame, 'Oops', 'Something went wrong' or exclamation marks in errors.

rules.title: Requirements up front
rules.rule: Known requirements show as helper text before input, phrased positively.

rules.title: Undo or confirm
rules.rule: Destructive actions act and offer undo when frequent and reversible, or confirm first when irreversible, shared or bulk.

rules.title: Confirmation shape
rules.rule: Confirmation titles name the action and object (never 'Are you sure?'); buttons are verb + object.

rules.title: Empty states move forward
rules.rule: Empty states say what belongs there and offer one next action; filtered empties name the query and offer Clear filters.

rules.title: Placeholder is an example
rules.rule: Placeholders show a realistic example in the accepted format, never an instruction.

rules.title: Cut 'successfully'
rules.rule: Cut 'successfully' and routine 'Please'.

rules.title: Parallel status copy
rules.rule: Status copy follows patterns: '-ing + object…' in progress, 'object + past tense' when done.
rules.notes: Text-only judge.

rules.title: Type to confirm
rules.rule: Deleting an account, workspace or repository asks for its name typed.

rules.title: Project idiom
rules.rule: Fixes use the project's own styling system and components (the design system), never a second one.

rules.title: Every state renders
rules.rule: Every surface renders its empty, loading, error and narrow states, and every reachable data state, with product-shaped mock data and real-use edge cases.

rules.title: Prefer delete
rules.rule: When code adds what deletion would fix (redundant ARIA, a separator space would carry), that is a finding.

rules.title: No removed signals
rules.rule: A change never removes accessibility, motion, direction or typography signals.

rules.title: Complete variant states
rules.rule: A new variant, size or theme covers hover, focus, active, disabled, loading and selected.

rules.title: Strings in the catalogue
rules.rule: A new user-facing string has a translation catalogue entry.
rules.notes: Only for apps with a catalogue.

rules.title: Content length
rules.rule: Components survive empty, one-word, several-sentence and one unbreakable 60-character string.

rules.title: Content shape
rules.rule: User text survives emoji, RTL, mixed direction, tall scripts and aligned numbers.

rules.title: Quantity
rules.rule: Repeating components handle zero, one, the realistic count and ten times it.

rules.title: Container squeeze
rules.rule: Components survive a narrow container, being squeezed by a sibling, and a very wide container.
rules.notes: Container widths, not viewport (the 320px value is kept as a container test).

rules.title: Stable states
rules.rule: Loading, error and disabled states do not shift layout, rely on color alone or collapse contrast.
rules.notes: R-state-shift decides the layout-shift part for hover, focus, tab selection and opened popups; loading, error and disabled states are not exercised yet.

rules.title: Environment
rules.rule: Components hold in dark mode, browser zoom and reduced motion.

rules.title: Loading holds still
rules.rule: Loading and pending states hold until switched, never resolving on a timeout.

rules.title: Rounding threshold
rules.rule: Rounding a design value to a token is fine up to 2px on size and within one color step; beyond that is a deviation.

rules.title: Fidelity compare
rules.rule: A build is compared side by side with its design at every frame width before it is done.

rules.title: No Figma URLs
rules.rule: No Figma asset URL remains in code.

rules.title: Self-contained SVG
rules.rule: SVG assets parse as XML with no duplicate IDs, unresolved url(#...) or external assets.

rules.title: Zoomed artwork reachable
rules.rule: Zoomed artwork stays in a scrollable viewport with every edge reachable.

rules.title: Sibling parity
rules.rule: A control added to one surface is added to siblings that carry its peers.

rules.title: Diff scope
rules.rule: A design build touches only what the frames show.

rules.title: Variant floor
rules.rule: Every candidate design clears the escalation floor before it is shown.
rules.notes: Process rule for design variants, not a page property.

rules.title: Evidence tiers
rules.rule: Every claimed value is tagged measured, derived or inferred.
rules.notes: Applies to the verifier's own reports.

rules.title: Slow-motion review
rules.rule: Review every animation at 1x, 0.5x, 0.25x and 0.125x before shipping.

rules.title: Dogfood the flow
rules.rule: Use what you build end to end before calling it done.

rules.title: Justify each addition
rules.rule: Add an element, animation or feature only when it clearly improves the result.

rules.title: Accessibility is release work
rules.rule: Accessibility issues are release work.
rules.notes: Process rule; the a11y rules above carry the checks.

rules.title: No near-miss alignment
rules.rule: Related elements (a row's items, stacked labels and fields, a column of cards) share edges and centers exactly; an offset of 1-3px between them fails.
rules.notes: Offsets above 3px are treated as deliberate. Implied by shared edges and the 2px rounding threshold.

rules.title: Handles center on the first line
rules.rule: Drag handles, row icons, checkboxes, bullets and toggles beside text are vertically centered on the first line box of that text, not on the whole block.
rules.notes: Ford's docs-editor complaint: the block grab bar does not line up with the block text.

rules.title: Shared baselines
rules.rule: Text in one row (label and value, tabs, adjacent buttons, inline chips) shares one baseline.

rules.title: Icons centered in their box
rules.rule: An icon in an icon button or beside a label is centered in its box within 0.5px, on the label's cap-height middle, after optical correction for asymmetric glyphs.

rules.title: Equal control heights in a row
rules.rule: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls and control chips in one row have the same height.

rules.title: Control heights from a scale
rules.rule: Control heights across the app come from a small token set on the 4px grid (for example 24, 28, 32px).
rules.notes: No control-height tokens exist yet; see token proposals.

rules.title: Gaps on the 4px grid
rules.rule: Rendered gaps, padding and margins are values from the DS space scale (4px grid with 2px and 6px half steps).

rules.title: Same padding in repeated items
rules.rule: Repeated rows, cards, list and menu items of one kind have identical padding and inner gaps.

rules.title: One indent step
rules.rule: Nested tree and outline levels indent by one constant step per level.

rules.title: State changes never shift layout
rules.rule: Hover, selection, focus, loading and copied states never change an element's size or move its neighbours (no border added on hover, no bolder text that widens a tab).
rules.notes: R-state-shift: layout boxes before and after hover, focus, tab selection and opening a popup; a neighbour (or the control itself) moved or resized by 1px or more fails (Ford: >= 1px).

rules.title: One icon size per role
rules.rule: Icons of one role on a surface (row icons, toolbar icons) render at one size.
